lumora.description: Lumora is an offline-first sports app for gym training, nutrition tracking, and health monitoring. All data stays local on the device with no account, server, or cloud sync. Training includes 151 exercises with muscle-group anatomy diagrams, custom workout plans, supersets, drag-to-reorder exercises, automatic rest timers, PR detection, and a rule-based coach that creates a personalized starter plan. Nutrition includes a meal diary for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, gram-based food entry, barcode scanning, Open Food Facts lookup, 76 built-in staple foods for offline use, and macro goals based on a calorie target. Health includes body-weight tracking with weekly averages, body measurements, a customizable daily tracker, automatic step counting, a training calendar with streaks, and a muscle balance view showing weekly training volume per muscle group.
